context_for_next_testing_agent: Search and Block/Report features have been verified through code review. The SearchDropdown component is integrated in feed/page.tsx at lines 388-390 and uses data-testid='search-input'. The dedicated search page at /search works correctly with data-testid='search-page-input'. BlockReportModal is integrated in ProfilePage.tsx at lines 1145-1156 with the trigger button at lines 587-612 using data-testid='block-report-btn'. To fully E2E test: (1) Create/use a verified test account, (2) Login and navigate to /feed, (3) Verify search dropdown appears in header, (4) Navigate to another user's profile to test block/report button, (5) Test filtering by verifying blocked user's posts don't appear in feed.
